title: TELOS Ed25519-signed integrity-hash receipt (telos/0.2-ed25519)
description: The signed contract version. Its required outer fields and `action_governed` payload constraints are identical to telos/0.1-unsigned; only `receipt_version`, `signing_status` and `signature` differ. The integrity hash is unchanged: a key-free SHA-256 over the canonical JSON (sort_keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii escapes) of `payload`. The signature is an Ed25519 signature over the ASCII bytes of the `integrity_hash` string, so it commits to the payload transitively. It does NOT cover `issued_at`, `agent_id`, `kind` or `engine`, which sit outside the hash. A successful verification establishes only that the signature verifies under a supplied public key for this payload hash. Binding that key to an identity or controller is outside this schema and verifier; the check does not establish when.

receipt_version.description: Which receipt contract produced this record. The name states the signing algorithm.

kind.description: What kind of record this is. Outside the hash and therefore outside the signature.

agent_id.description: Which agent did the work. Outside the hash and therefore outside the signature.

payload.description: The part the integrity hash covers, and so the part the signature commits to. Must be JSON-native and finite.

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of issue. Deliberately outside the hash so the same logical payload always yields the same hash. NOT covered by the signature: a signed receipt does not date itself.

integrity_hash.description: Key-free SHA-256 over the canonical JSON serialization of `payload`, and the exact string the signature is computed over.

covered_fields.description: States exactly what the hash covers.

signing_status.description: The receipt's own declaration that it carries an Ed25519 signature.

signature.description: The signature block. A verifier must check `algorithm` and `covers` before verifying, and refuse a receipt declaring anything it does not implement rather than verify the wrong bytes.

covers.const: integrity_hash (ASCII bytes of the sha256: string)
covers.description: States exactly what was signed, so a verifier signs the same bytes or refuses.

public_key.description: Base64 of the 32 raw public key bytes. DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. This is not a trust anchor: a forger writes both the signature and the key printed beside it. A verifier must check the signature against a key obtained out of band, and must not reach a pass using this field.

key_id.description: Optional label for the signing key, SHA-256 over the 32 raw public key bytes. Also diagnostic, and carries no more authority than `public_key`.

value.description: Base64 of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the ASCII bytes of `integrity_hash`.

engine.description: Which engine produced the payload. Outside the hash and therefore outside the signature.

action_params_hash.description: A producer-supplied value in sha256:<64 lowercase hex> form. This public contract does not define which representation of the action parameters is hashed, or how to reproduce or open the value, and telos-verify does not recompute it. Omitting raw arguments avoids directly echoing them, but this deterministic digest can reveal equality and support offline guessing of low-entropy values; it is not a confidentiality guarantee.

verdict.description: The review outcome, from the public verdict vocabulary.

composite_score.description: Overall score of the action against its purpose anchor.

pa_id.description: The purpose anchor: the declared, human-specified purpose the action was measured against.
